title: stacksplit
summary: MSUI matches the current Benilla StackSplitFrame: 172x96 cropped UI-MoneyFrame plate, authored arrows and panel-button faces, BOTTOMRIGHT-to-owner-TOPRIGHT positioning, initial count 1, full-stack maximum, live owner/count tracking, disabled arrow states, typed digits/backspace/arrows/Enter, and Cancel/Escape closure. Geometry and transitions are centralized in StackSplitUiLaw; ImGui is only the transparent render/hit-test host.

openItems.text: Vanilla StackSplitFrame visuals absent: UI-MoneyFrame parchment plate, Arrow-Left/Right spinner buttons with disabled states, OKAY/CANCEL UI-Panel-Button faces (MSUI draws an ImGui slider window instead)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: replaced the SliderInt window with the cropped UI-MoneyFrame plate, authored arrow assets and disabled states, exact 64x24 UI-Panel-Button faces, and focused clinical coverage.

openItems.text: Frame is anchored at the mouse cursor, not to the owning slot (ref anchors BOTTOMRIGHT of the owner button)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: StackSplitUiLaw now attaches frame BOTTOMRIGHT to the owning slot TOPRIGHT and the runtime follows that live owner position instead of the mouse.

openItems.text: Split maximum is stackCount-1 (ref allows splitting up to the full stack count)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: maximum now equals the live stack count; initial split is 1 and all arrow, typed-digit, and live-resize transitions clamp to [1,maxStack].
